title: Pocketwire Rewards Schedule of Earning Rates by Tier
content:
Pocketwire Rewards earns points on Pocketwire debit card spend at the rates below, fixed for each tier. Every rate is stated in points per US dollar of purchase spend.

## Base rate and category bonus rates

The category bonus is earned in addition to the base rate, on purchases in the merchant category named, and only inside the quarterly category bonus spend cap.

| Tier | Base rate | Grocery bonus | Dining bonus | Gas bonus | Travel bonus | Streaming bonus | Online retail bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1.0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 1.25 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 1.5 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 2.0 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 2.5 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 3.0 | 3 | 4 | 2 | 4 | 3 | 2 |

A bonus rate of 0 means that the tier earns no category bonus in that category.

## Quarterly category bonus spend cap

The cap is the spend per calendar quarter, across all bonus categories together, that can earn category bonus points; spend above it earns base points only.

| Tier | Quarterly category bonus spend cap (USD) |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 2500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 5000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 7500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 10000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 25000.00 |

## Direct-deposit rate lift

The direct-deposit rate lift is additional base points per US dollar, earned when the linked personal account received direct deposits at or above the direct-deposit lift threshold in the previous calendar month.

| Tier | Direct-deposit rate lift (points per USD) | Direct-deposit lift threshold (USD, previous calendar month) |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 0 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 0.25 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 0.25 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 0.5 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 0.5 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 1.0 | 500.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- Which tiers earn a gas bonus? Gold and Platinum earn 1 additional point per USD, Diamond and Obsidian 2; Member and Silver show 0 and earn none.
- Which tiers earn an online retail bonus? Platinum and Diamond earn 1 additional point per USD and Obsidian 2; the other tiers show 0.
- Does a Member earn a direct-deposit rate lift? The Member row shows a lift of 0, so meeting the 500.00 USD threshold adds nothing to the Member base rate; on Obsidian the same deposits add 1.0 point per USD.
